title: Recommendation and purchase-intent remarks
summary: This topic centers on broad recommendation language and personal purchase framing, with a few clear endorsements but several fragments too incomplete to determine sentiment reliably.

positive.summary: Positive reviews recommend the G60 for smooth delivery, strong but quiet performance, and composed ride comfort.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention wanting the car, calling it the right sedan, or introducing a recommendation without enough context to confirm sentiment.

limitations: Several fragments are short or incomplete, which limits confidence in interpreting sentiment from the wording alone.
The topic groups together recommendation phrases and purchase-intent statements that are related but not fully consistent in focus.
Examples are few and stratified, so they are insufficient to support broader conclusions beyond the sampled fragments.
